name: Alternating Dumbbell Bench Press
start: Lying on flat bench, both dumbbells pressed up, arms straight over chest
finish: Right dumbbell lowered to chest while left stays pressed up, arm straight
avoid: Not both dumbbells moving together, and not kettlebells on the floor.

name: Single-Arm Cable Chest Press
start: Standing staggered, back to chest-height pulley, handle in right hand beside chest, left hand free
finish: Right arm pressed straight forward at chest height, torso square, left hand empty
avoid: Not both hands holding handles; only one arm presses.

name: Archer Push-Up
start: Top of push-up, hands placed very wide, both arms straight
finish: Chest lowered toward right hand, right elbow bent, left arm straight out to side
avoid: Not a low centred push-up sliding side to side (typewriter).

name: Clap Push-Up
start: Top of push-up, arms straight, hands under shoulders, body straight
finish: Upper body airborne, both hands off floor clapping under chest, toes still down
avoid: Not a push-up where the hands never leave the floor.

name: Explosive Depth Push-Up
start: Top of push-up, each hand on a low box, feet on floor
finish: Hands dropped to floor between the boxes, elbows bent, chest low near floor
avoid: Not lowering with hands staying on the boxes (deficit push-up).

name: Deficit Push-Up
start: Top of push-up, each hand on a low block a few inches high, feet on floor
finish: Chest lowered between the blocks, below hand level, elbows bent
avoid: Not a floor push-up, nor tall boxes that tilt the body steeply.

name: Weighted Push-Up
start: Top of push-up, arms straight, weight plate resting flat on upper back
finish: Chest lowered near floor, elbows bent, plate still on upper back
avoid: Not unloaded, and not dumbbells used only as hand supports.

name: Spiderman Push-Up
start: Top of push-up, arms straight, body straight, both feet on floor
finish: Chest lowered, right knee drawn out to the side up to right elbow
avoid: Not a knee drive from a held low plank; arms start straight.

name: Pendlay Row
start: Torso bent parallel to floor, overhand grip, barbell resting on floor below shoulders
finish: Barbell pulled to lower chest, torso still parallel, elbows above back
avoid: Not a row starting with the bar hanging at knee height.

name: Seal Row
start: Lying face down on high flat bench, barbell hanging at arm's length, plates clear of floor
finish: Barbell pulled up to touch underside of bench, elbows above back, legs still on bench
avoid: Not an incline bench, cambered bar, or plates resting on the floor.

name: Meadows Row
start: Side-on to landmine bar, left forearm on forward left knee, right hand overhand on bar end
finish: Bar end rowed up to hip height, right elbow high and flared, torso still bent
avoid: Not standing parallel to the bar gripping the shaft behind the plates.

name: Wide-Grip Cable Row
start: Seated at low pulley, feet on platform, long straight bar held overhand, hands wide, arms straight
finish: Bar pulled to upper abdomen, elbows flared wide, torso upright
avoid: Not a close V-handle or rope; hands well outside shoulders.

name: Cable Pullover
start: Lying face up on flat bench, head toward low pulley, bar behind head, arms nearly straight
finish: Bar pulled over in an arc to above chest, arms still nearly straight
avoid: Not a standing straight-arm pulldown from a high pulley.

name: Machine Pullover
start: Seated in pullover machine, elbows on arm pads raised high behind head, hands on bar
finish: Arm pads swept down in an arc, bar at stomach, elbows by sides
avoid: Not a dumbbell pullover on a bench, or a pulldown machine.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
start: Dead hang from parallel handles about shoulder-width apart, palms facing each other
finish: Chin above handles, elbows bent at sides, palms still facing each other
avoid: Not a V-handle hung over the bar with hands touching.

name: Weighted Chin-Up
start: Dead hang, underhand shoulder-width grip, weight plate hanging from dip belt between legs
finish: Chin above bar, palms facing body, plate still hanging from belt
avoid: Not an overhand weighted pull-up, and not an unloaded chin-up.

name: Commando Pull-Up
start: Hanging side-on under bar, hands close together one in front of the other, arms straight
finish: Pulled up, head beside bar on left side, bar touching right shoulder
avoid: Not facing the bar square-on with a shoulder-width mixed grip.

name: Archer Pull-Up
start: Dead hang from bar, very wide overhand grip, both arms straight
finish: Chin beside right hand above bar, right elbow bent, left arm straight along bar
avoid: Not both elbows bent with the body just leaning to one side.

name: L-Sit Pull-Up
start: Hanging overhand from bar, arms straight, both legs straight and raised level in an L
finish: Chin above bar, legs still straight and horizontal in the L
avoid: Not knees bent or tucked; legs stay straight and horizontal.

name: Feet-Elevated Inverted Row
start: Hanging under racked bar, overhand grip, arms straight, heels on bench, body straight and level
finish: Chest pulled to bar, body still straight, heels still on bench
avoid: Not heels on the floor; feet must rest on a bench.

name: Towel Pull-Up
start: Dead hang, two towels looped over bar, one towel gripped in each hand
finish: Pulled up, chin level with hands, both hands still gripping the towels
avoid: Not one hand on the bar and only one on a towel.

name: Trap-Bar Shrug
start: Standing tall inside trap bar, holding side handles, arms straight, shoulders low
finish: Same upright stance, shoulders shrugged up toward ears, arms still straight
avoid: Not a trap-bar deadlift; hips and knees stay straight, only shoulders rise.

name: Dumbbell Y-Raise
start: Bent over at hips, torso near parallel to floor, dumbbell in each hand hanging down
finish: Torso still bent over, straight arms raised past head in a Y, thumbs up
avoid: Not an upright raise stopping at shoulder height; arms must pass the head.

name: Cable Y-Raise
start: Standing between two low pulleys, cables crossed, hands crossed in front of thighs holding handles
finish: Both straight arms raised overhead, angled out to form a Y, thumbs up
avoid: Not stopping at shoulder height like a lateral or front raise.

name: Prone Y-Raise
start: Chest down on low incline bench, light dumbbell in each hand hanging below shoulders
finish: Straight arms raised level with body, angled out in a Y past the head, thumbs up
avoid: Not arms parallel like an I, or straight out sideways like a T.

name: Prone W-Raise
start: Chest down on low incline bench, a light dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging toward floor
finish: Elbows bent and pulled back by ribs, forearms turned up, arms and head forming a W
avoid: Not straight arms out to the sides in a T.

name: Scapular Wall Slide
start: Back, head and hips against wall, elbows bent at shoulder height, backs of hands on wall
finish: Arms slid up the wall overhead into a Y, elbows nearly straight, still touching wall
avoid: Not facing the wall, and not arms lifted off the wall.

name: Z-Press
start: Seated on floor, legs straight out in front, no back support, barbell at front of shoulders
finish: Barbell pressed overhead, arms locked, torso upright, legs still straight on floor
avoid: Not a one-arm kettlebell straddle press, and not seated on a bench.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
start: Seated in lateral-raise machine, arm pads against outer upper arms, elbows down at sides
finish: Both arm pads raised out to the sides, elbows level with shoulders
avoid: Not a machine shoulder press or a reverse fly machine.

name: Leaning Cable Lateral Raise
start: Left hand gripping machine frame, body leaning right, right hand holding low-pulley handle at thighs
finish: Still leaning right, right arm raised straight out to side at shoulder height
avoid: Not standing upright with the free hand on the hip.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Lateral Raise
start: Standing, low pulley on left, cable runs behind back to right hand at right hip
finish: Right arm raised straight out to side at shoulder height, cable still behind body
avoid: Not the cable crossing in front of the body.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
start: Facing away from low pulley, staggered stance, single handle, one straight arm angled behind body.
finish: Same stance, upper arm still angled back, handle curled to shoulder, cable running back to pulley.
avoid: Not facing the pulley with the upper arm hanging at the side.

name: Chin-Up Curl
start: Hanging from pull-up bar, underhand shoulder-width grip, arms straight, feet off the floor.
finish: Elbows bent, upper arms still pointing up and forward, forehead at bar, body leaning back.
avoid: Not a standard chin-up with chin over bar and elbows at ribs.

name: Dead Hang
start: Standing under pull-up bar, both hands gripping it overhand, arms straight, feet still grounded.
finish: Hanging still from both hands, arms fully straight, feet off the ground, legs hanging below.
avoid: Not a pull-up or scapular pull-up; body never rises.

name: Towel Dead Hang
start: Standing under pull-up bar, two towels draped over it, one fist gripping each towel's ends.
finish: Hanging still from the two towels, arms straight, hands below bar, feet off floor.
avoid: Not one hand on bar and one on towel, nor pulling up.

name: Farmer Hold
start: Crouched between two heavy dumbbells on the floor, one hand gripping each handle.
finish: Standing still, feet planted hip-width, a dumbbell hanging at each side, arms straight.
avoid: Not a farmer's walk mid-stride, nor a shrug.

name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
start: Leaning on racked bar at chest height, arms straight, body straight, feet back on floor
finish: Elbows bent, forehead dropped below bar, body still straight on toes
avoid: Not chains or added load, and not the floor forearm-plank version.

name: Pendulum Squat
start: In pendulum squat machine, shoulders under pads, back on pad, feet on platform, legs straight.
finish: Deep squat, hips near heels, knees far forward, swinging arm lowered through its arc.
avoid: Not a linear-sled hack squat, leg press or barbell hack squat.

name: Single-Leg Leg Press
start: Seated in 45-degree leg press, only right foot on platform, right knee bent deep
finish: Right leg pressed nearly straight, platform pushed up, left foot still off platform
avoid: Not both feet on the platform pressing together.

name: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
start: Split stance, front foot on low step, rear foot on floor, dumbbells at sides, standing tall.
finish: Same feet, lowered, rear knee near floor, front foot still on step, dumbbells at sides.
avoid: Not rear foot on a bench, nor a step-back lunge off a plate.

name: Peterson Step-Up
start: With dumbbells, right foot on low step, heel raised, knee past toes, left heel on floor
finish: Right knee straightened, right heel still raised, left foot lifted clear, dumbbells at sides
avoid: Not a flat-footed step-up onto a box; working heel stays raised.

name: Cyclist Squat
start: Standing tall, barbell across upper back, feet close together, heels raised on wedge or plates.
finish: Deep squat, torso upright, knees far forward past toes, heels still raised.
avoid: Not a flat-footed narrow squat, nor a sissy squat leaning back.

name: Spanish Squat
start: Standing facing rack, heavy band behind both knees anchored to rack at knee height
finish: Sat back to thighs near parallel, shins vertical, torso upright, arms forward, band taut
avoid: Not a band under the feet; it loops behind the knees.

name: Assisted Pistol Squat
start: On one leg beside rack upright, near hand gripping it, free leg held straight in front.
finish: Full-depth one-leg squat, hips near heel, free leg straight forward off floor, hand still on upright.
avoid: Not an unsupported or weighted pistol, nor a box step-down.

name: Assisted Nordic Curl
start: Tall-kneeling on pad, ankles under padded bar, band from high anchor behind looped around chest
finish: Lowered forward from knees, body straight knees to head, band stretched, chest close to floor
avoid: Not an unassisted Nordic with no band around the chest.

name: Slider Hamstring Curl
start: Lying face up, heels on sliders, legs nearly straight, hips lifted off floor
finish: Heels slid in toward buttocks, knees bent, hips high in bridge, shoulders on floor
avoid: Not hips resting on the floor (heel slide), and not a stability ball.

name: Kettlebell Swing
start: Hinged over, both hands on one kettlebell swung back high between thighs, arms straight
finish: Standing tall, arms straight forward, kettlebell at chest height, both hands on handle
avoid: Not a one-arm swing, and not swung up overhead.

name: B-Stance Romanian Deadlift
start: Left foot flat, right foot back on its toes level with left heel, dumbbells at thighs
finish: Hinged forward, back flat, dumbbells at mid-shin, left knee slightly bent, right toes still down
avoid: Not rear leg lifted off the floor, and not feet side by side.

name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
start: Upper back on flat bench, hips lowered toward floor, both hands holding one dumbbell on hips
finish: Hips raised level with knees and shoulders, shins vertical, dumbbell still on hips
avoid: Not a barbell across the hips, and not back on a ball.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
start: Upper back on bench, hips low, right foot flat, left foot raised, dumbbell on right hip
finish: Pushed up on right leg, hips level with shoulders, left foot still raised, dumbbell on hip
avoid: Not shoulders on the floor, and not both feet down.

name: Machine Glute Kickback
start: In kickback machine, chest on pad, right foot on foot plate, right knee under hips
finish: Right leg pushed back until thigh is in line with torso, chest still on pad
avoid: Not a cable ankle-cuff kickback or an unloaded hands-and-knees kickback.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
start: Standing, low pulley on left, ankle cuff on right ankle, feet together, left hand on frame
finish: Right leg raised straight out to the right side, away from pulley, cable taut
avoid: Not cuff on the leg nearest the pulley pulled inward (adduction).

name: Copenhagen Plank
start: Lying on right side on forearm, hips on floor, left ankle on bench, right leg underneath
finish: Body raised straight, held on right forearm and left ankle on bench, right foot off floor
avoid: Not a side plank with both feet on the floor.

name: Cossack Squat
start: Standing tall in very wide stance, toes slightly out, kettlebell held at chest with both hands
finish: Hips sunk to right heel, left leg straight, left toes pointing up, kettlebell still at chest
avoid: Not a barbell lateral lunge to parallel with the straight leg's foot flat.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
start: Right forefoot on step edge, heel below step, left foot raised, dumbbell in right hand
finish: High on right toes, left foot still raised, dumbbell in right hand, left hand on wall
avoid: Not both feet on the step, and not seated.

name: Tibialis Raise
start: Side view, back leaning on wall, both feet out in front, soles flat on floor
finish: Same lean on wall, heels on floor, both forefeet lifted high toward shins
avoid: Not a calf raise onto the toes, and no bar on the back.

name: Weighted Tibialis Raise
start: Seated on high bench, feet off floor, dumbbell held upright between both feet, toes pointing down
finish: Both feet flexed up toward shins, lifting the dumbbell, feet still off floor
avoid: Not a bar on the back; load must sit on the feet.

name: Toe Walk
start: Side view, walking high on balls of feet, heels raised, right foot stepping forward
finish: Next step, left foot ahead on tiptoes, both heels still well off floor
avoid: Not a stationary calf raise with feet side by side.

name: Heel Walk
start: Side view, walking on heels, both forefeet lifted off floor, right heel stepping forward
finish: Next step, left heel planted ahead, toes of both feet still raised off floor
avoid: Not a stationary toe raise with feet side by side.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
start: Hanging from pull-up bar, overhand grip, arms straight, legs straight and together below.
finish: Still hanging, legs kept straight and together, lifted to horizontal or slightly higher.
avoid: Not a bent-knee raise, nor toes-to-bar, nor a captain's chair.

name: L-Sit
start: Seated on floor, legs straight, hands planted beside hips on floor or parallettes, arms straight.
finish: Pressed up on straight arms, hips off floor, straight legs held horizontal, body forming an L.
avoid: Not a captain's-chair knee raise or a hanging pike from a bar.

name: Weighted Decline Sit-Up
start: On decline bench, feet hooked under pads, lying back, weight plate held flat against chest.
finish: Same bench and feet, torso curled up to upright, plate still held against the chest.
avoid: Not pressing the weight overhead, nor a band or unloaded crunch.

name: Hollow-Body Hold
start: Lying flat on back on mat, arms straight overhead, legs straight together on the floor.
finish: Shoulders and straight legs held just off floor, arms by ears, lower back on floor.
avoid: Not a tuck crunch or dead bug with bent, moving legs.

name: Weighted Plank
start: On forearms and knees on mat, weight plate resting flat on upper back.
finish: Knees lifted into forearm plank, body straight head to heels, plate still on upper back.
avoid: Not an unloaded plank or a side plank.

name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
start: Half-kneeling facing landmine, right knee down, left foot forward, bar end in right hand at shoulder
finish: Right arm pressed straight up and forward, still half-kneeling, left hand free
avoid: Not standing or tall-kneeling; one knee down, one foot forward.

name: Landmine Push Press
start: Facing anchor, bar end in right hand at right shoulder, knees bent in short dip
finish: Legs straight, body leaning into bar, right arm locked out up and forward
avoid: Not a strict press with legs straight, nor a deep squat-to-press.

name: Meadows Landmine Row
start: Bar running out to right, left forearm on forward knee, right hand overhand on bar end
finish: Bar end rowed up to hip height, right elbow high and flared, torso still bent
avoid: Not standing parallel to the bar gripping the shaft behind the plates.

name: Landmine Squat
start: Standing tall facing anchor, both hands cupping bar end at upper chest, feet shoulder-width
finish: Squatted deep, thighs below parallel, torso upright, bar end still held at chest
avoid: Not pressing the bar end overhead; it stays at the chest.

name: Landmine Hack Squat
start: Facing away from anchor, bar end on upper back, both hands on it, legs straight
finish: Squatted to thighs below parallel, torso leaning back into bar, bar end still on upper back
avoid: Not facing the anchor, and not a free barbell behind the legs.

name: Landmine Reverse Lunge
start: Standing tall facing anchor, feet together, both hands holding bar end at chest
finish: Right foot stepped back, right knee near floor, left knee bent, bar end at chest
avoid: Not stepping forward, and not dumbbells or a free barbell.

name: Landmine Lateral Lunge
start: Standing tall facing anchor, feet together, both hands holding bar end at chest
finish: Stepped wide to right, right knee bent, hips back, left leg straight, bar end at chest
avoid: Not a barbell across the back; the bar end is held at chest.

name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
start: Standing tall facing anchor, both hands gripping bar end at hips, arms straight, knees slightly bent
finish: Hinged forward with flat back, hips pushed back, bar end lowered to mid-shin, arms straight
avoid: Not a bent-over row; arms stay straight and the hips move.

name: Landmine Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
start: Facing anchor, standing on left leg, right hand holding bar end at right hip
finish: Hinged on left leg, torso near level, right leg raised behind, bar end at shin height
avoid: Not a kettlebell or dumbbell, and not both feet on the floor.

name: Landmine Anti-Rotation Press
start: Standing, landmine anchor off to the left, both hands holding bar end against mid-chest
finish: Both arms pressed straight out in front, bar end at arm's length, chest still facing forward
avoid: Not facing the anchor to press, and not swinging the bar side to side.

name: Landmine Clean and Press
start: Facing anchor, hips back, knees bent, right hand gripping bar end beside right shin
finish: Standing tall, right arm locked out up and forward, bar end above head height
avoid: Not starting with the bar end already at the shoulder.

name: Landmine Split Jerk
start: Facing anchor, feet side by side, bar end in right hand at right shoulder, knees dipped
finish: Feet split, left foot forward, both knees bent, right arm locked out up and forward
avoid: Not feet staying together at lockout like a push press.

name: Explosive Medicine-Ball Push-Up
start: Top of push-up, both hands together on medicine ball, arms straight, feet on floor
finish: Hands dropped off ball to floor either side of it, elbows bent, chest just above ball
avoid: Not a kettlebell or boxes, and not hands staying on the ball.

name: Medicine-Ball Rotational Slam
start: Standing, feet shoulder-width, medicine ball overhead in both hands, arms extended
finish: Torso turned right, both hands driving ball into floor outside right foot, left heel up
avoid: Not slammed straight down between the feet, and not one-handed.

name: Medicine-Ball Side Throw
start: Standing side-on, target on left, torso turned right, medicine ball in both hands beside right hip
finish: Torso turned left, arms swung through at hip height, ball released sideways to the left
avoid: Not a back-to-back partner hand-off; the ball must be thrown.

name: Medicine-Ball Rotational Wall Throw
start: Standing side-on, wall on left, feet wide, medicine ball in both hands at right hip
finish: Rotated to face wall, arms extended toward it, right heel turned up, ball flying into wall
avoid: Not a square-on two-hand chest push into the wall.

name: Medicine-Ball Shot-Put Throw
start: Left shoulder toward target, weight on bent right leg, ball in right palm at right shoulder
finish: Hips and chest turned to target, right arm punched straight out, ball leaving right hand
avoid: Not a two-hand chest pass, and not pushing a hanging bag.

name: Half-Kneeling Rotational Throw
start: Half-kneeling, right knee down, left foot forward, medicine ball in both hands at right hip
finish: Torso rotated left, both arms extended left at chest height, ball leaving hands, knee still down
avoid: Not kneeling on both knees, and not a straight chest push.

name: Medicine-Ball Sprawl-to-Slam
start: Sprawl: hands on medicine ball on floor, legs kicked straight back, hips dropped to floor
finish: Back on feet, bent over, both hands slamming ball into floor in front of feet
avoid: Not a standing slam alone; first photo must show the sprawl.

name: Medicine-Ball Slam-to-Sprint
start: Bent forward, both hands slamming medicine ball into floor in front of feet
finish: Ball left on floor, sprinting away from it, body leaning forward, right knee driven up
avoid: Not a slam alone; second photo must show a sprint stride.

name: Weighted Box Jump
start: Standing facing plyo box, light dumbbell in each hand at sides, knees bent in quarter squat
finish: Landed on top of box on both feet in half squat, dumbbells still at sides
avoid: Not unloaded, and not starting seated on a bench.

name: Single-Leg Broad Jump
start: Standing on right leg, knee and hips bent, arms swung back, left foot off floor
finish: Landed forward on right foot only, knee bent, arms forward, left foot still off floor
avoid: Not a two-foot take-off, and not small repeated hops over cones.

name: Pogo Jump
start: Standing tall on balls of both feet, legs nearly straight, arms at sides, heels up
finish: Airborne a few inches straight up, legs straight, toes pointed down
avoid: Not with a jump rope, and not hopping forward over cones.

name: Zercher Carry
start: Standing tall, loaded barbell in crooks of both elbows, held against stomach, hands clasped
finish: Walking forward mid-stride, right foot ahead, bar still in elbow crooks, torso upright
avoid: Not squatting in place; the person must be walking.

name: Cable Press Around
start: Standing, back to chest-height pulley, handle in right hand beside chest, elbow bent
finish: Right arm straightened across the body, hand in front of left shoulder
avoid: Not a two-arm press straight forward, and not a straight-arm fly.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chest Press
start: Half-kneeling, right knee down, left foot forward, back to pulley, handle in right hand at chest
finish: Right arm pressed straight forward at chest height, still half-kneeling, torso square
avoid: Not standing, seated or two-arm; one knee down, one arm pressing.

name: Cable Squeeze Press
start: Standing, back to two chest-height pulleys, handles pressed together at mid-chest, palms facing each other
finish: Both arms pressed straight forward at chest height, handles still touching each other
avoid: Not a regular cable press with handles starting wide beside the chest.

name: Cable Decline Press
start: Staggered stance, back to two high pulleys, handles beside upper chest, elbows bent
finish: Both arms pressed straight, angled down and forward, hands level with navel
avoid: Not a straight-ahead chest-height press; arms must angle downward.

name: Single-Arm Cable Floor Press
start: Lying face up on floor beside low pulley, handle in right hand at chest, elbow down
finish: Right arm pressed straight up over chest, left arm resting on floor
avoid: Not a dumbbell or kettlebell floor press, and not two arms.

name: Cable Resisted Push-Up
start: Top of push-up facing cable stack, low-pulley cable clipped to strap around upper back
finish: Chest lowered near floor, elbows bent, cable still taut from upper back to pulley
avoid: Not an unloaded push-up, and not a standing cable chest press.

name: Cable Y Raise
start: Standing between two low pulleys, cables crossed, hands crossed in front of thighs holding handles
finish: Both straight arms raised overhead, angled out to form a Y, thumbs up
avoid: Not stopping at shoulder height like a lateral or front raise.

name: Cable Scaption Raise
start: Standing, low pulley on left, right hand holding handle in front of thighs, thumb up
finish: Right arm raised straight to shoulder height, angled 30 degrees forward of side, thumb up
avoid: Not a palm-down lateral raise or a straight-ahead front raise.

name: Cable Cuban Rotation
start: Facing low pulley, bar held wide overhand, upper arms level with shoulders, forearms hanging down
finish: Upper arms still level with shoulders, forearms rotated up vertical, bar in front of forehead
avoid: Not elbows pinned at the sides, and not pressing the bar overhead.

name: Cable Serratus Punch
start: Standing square, back to shoulder-height pulley, right arm straight forward holding handle, shoulder drawn back
finish: Same straight arm reaching further forward, right shoulder pushed forward, torso still square
avoid: Not a two-arm chest press; elbow stays straight, only the shoulder moves.

name: Cable Standing Punch
start: Left foot forward, back to chest-height pulley, handle in right hand at chin, right shoulder back
finish: Right arm punched straight forward at shoulder height, hips and shoulders turned forward, right heel up
avoid: Not a two-arm press, and not a square stance without torso turn.

name: Cable Incline Press-Around
start: Staggered stance, back to low pulley, handle in right hand beside chest, elbow bent
finish: Right arm pressed up and across, hand in front of left shoulder at eye height
avoid: Not a two-arm incline bench press; one hand sweeps up across midline.

name: Cable Front-Foot-Elevated Press
start: Split stance, front foot on low step, back to chest-height pulleys, handles at chest
finish: Both arms pressed straight forward at chest height, front foot still on step
avoid: Not a flat-floor split stance; front foot must be raised.

name: Chest-Supported Cable Row
start: Chest on incline bench facing low pulley, arms straight, both hands on a V-handle
finish: V-handle pulled to top edge of bench, elbows behind torso, chest still on pad
avoid: Not a seated cable row with chest free, nor a dumbbell or T-bar row.

name: Rope Cable Row
start: Seated at low pulley, feet on platform, rope held at both ends, arms straight
finish: Rope pulled to lower ribs, ends split either side, elbows close beside torso
avoid: Not rope pulled to the neck with elbows raised high.

name: Cable Trap Raise
start: Bent forward at hips, low pulley on left, right hand holding handle near left knee
finish: Right arm raised straight, diagonally up and out past head, thumb up, still bent forward
avoid: Not a cable shrug; the straight arm must rise diagonally past the head.

name: Cable High Pull
start: Facing low pulley, straight bar overhand just above knees, hips back, knees bent, arms straight
finish: Standing tall on toes, bar pulled to upper chest, elbows high and wide above hands
avoid: Not a strict upright row with legs straight and still throughout.

name: Incline Cable Curl
start: Lying back on incline bench, low pulley behind, single handle, one straight arm hanging behind torso.
finish: Same bench position, upper arm still angled back, handle curled up to the shoulder.
avoid: Not lying flat on the floor, nor an incline dumbbell curl.

name: Cable Concentration Curl
start: Seated on bench facing low pulley, single handle, one elbow on inner thigh, arm straight.
finish: Same seat, elbow still on inner thigh, handle curled up toward the shoulder.
avoid: Not a dumbbell concentration curl, nor a standing cable curl.

name: Cable Spider Curl
start: Chest-down on incline bench, head toward low pulley, short bar in both hands, arms hanging vertical.
finish: Same position, upper arms still hanging vertical, bar curled up to the shoulders.
avoid: Not a preacher curl with upper arms on a pad, nor a free EZ-bar.

name: Cross-Body Cable Curl
start: Standing side-on to low pulley, single handle in near hand, thumb-up grip, arm straight at side.
finish: Same stance, handle curled across the body to the opposite shoulder, thumb still up.
avoid: Not a palm-up curl straight to the same shoulder, nor a dumbbell.

name: Cross-Body Cable Triceps Extension
start: Side-on to shoulder-high pulley, far hand holds single handle by other shoulder, arm bent across chest.
finish: Same stance, working arm straightened out sideways away from pulley, about shoulder height.
avoid: Not a one-arm pushdown with the elbow pinned at the side.

name: Cable Triceps Kickback
start: Bent over facing low pulley, single handle in one hand, upper arm along torso, elbow bent.
finish: Same bent-over position, that arm fully straight behind, in line with the torso.
avoid: Not a dumbbell kickback, nor an upright cable pushdown.

name: Cable Wrist Extension
start: Seated facing low pulley, forearms on thighs, straight bar held palms down, hands dropped over knees.
finish: Same position, forearms still on thighs, backs of hands raised, knuckles above the wrists.
avoid: Not a palms-up wrist curl, nor a dumbbell or barbell version.

name: Cable Belt Squat
start: Standing tall facing low pulley, dip belt around hips clipped to the cable, feet shoulder-width.
finish: Squatted to thighs about parallel, cable taut to the hip belt, hands empty, torso upright.
avoid: Not a plate hung from a dip belt, nor handles held in hands.

name: Cable Goblet Squat
start: Facing low pulley, both hands cupping single handle at chest, elbows down, standing tall.
finish: Deep squat, elbows between knees, handle still held at chest, cable running to pulley.
avoid: Not a kettlebell goblet squat, nor handles held at the sides.

name: Cable Front Squat
start: Facing low pulley, straight bar held at front of shoulders, elbows high, standing tall.
finish: Deep squat, thighs at least parallel, bar still racked at shoulders, elbows high, torso upright.
avoid: Not handles hanging at the sides, nor a barbell front squat.

name: Cable Good Morning
start: Facing low pulley, standing tall, both hands holding rope ends against upper chest, knees slightly bent.
finish: Hinged at hips, flat back near level with floor, knees slightly bent, rope still at chest.
avoid: Not a pull-through reaching between legs, nor a band good morning.

name: Cable Single-Leg Deadlift
start: Facing low pulley, standing on one leg, single handle in opposite hand, arm hanging straight.
finish: Hinged forward on that leg, free leg straight back, torso near level, handle low toward pulley.
avoid: Not a two-leg cable deadlift or pull-through, nor a kettlebell.

name: Cable Step-Up
start: Facing box with low pulley beyond, single handle at chest, one foot up on box.
finish: Stepped forward onto box, standing tall on that leg, rear foot off floor, handle at chest.
avoid: Not dumbbells or a barbell, nor a sideways step-up.

name: Cable Lateral Step-Up
start: Side-on to low pulley, single handle at chest, box on far side, far foot on box.
finish: Stepped sideways away from stack onto box on far leg, near foot hovering, handle at chest.
avoid: Not a forward step-up, nor dumbbells held at the sides.

name: Cable Skater Squat
start: Facing low pulley, on one leg, free foot raised behind, both hands on handle, arms forward.
finish: Squatted deep on standing leg, free knee lowered behind almost touching floor, arms still forward.
avoid: Not a pistol with the free leg in front, nor a split squat.

name: Cable Hip Thrust
start: Upper back on bench, facing low pulley, hip belt clipped to cable, hips down near floor.
finish: Hips raised level with knees and shoulders, shins vertical, upper back on bench, cable taut.
avoid: Not a standing pull-through, nor a barbell or band thrust.

name: Cable Quadruped Hip Extension
start: On all fours, feet toward low pulley, cuff on one ankle, that knee tucked under hip.
finish: Cuffed leg extended straight back in line with torso, knee straight, other knee down.
avoid: Not a standing kickback, nor a bent-knee donkey kick.

name: Cable Donkey Kick
start: On all fours, feet toward low pulley, cuff on one ankle, that knee bent under hip.
finish: Cuffed leg kicked up, knee still bent 90 degrees, thigh level with back, sole facing ceiling.
avoid: Not a standing kickback, nor a bodyweight or straight-leg kick.

name: Cable Fire Hydrant
start: On all fours side-on to low pulley, far ankle cuffed, cable running under body, knees down.
finish: Cuffed leg lifted out sideways, knee still bent 90 degrees, thigh raised to hip height.
avoid: Not a backward kick, nor a fire hydrant with no cable.

name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
start: Side-on to low pulley, cuff on far ankle, cable across shins, feet together, hand on frame.
finish: Cuffed leg lifted straight out sideways away from the stack, standing leg straight, torso upright.
avoid: Not adduction pulling the near leg inward, nor a seated machine.

name: Cable Hamstring Curl
start: Face down on bench, feet toward low pulley, cuff on one ankle, both legs straight.
finish: Same position, cuffed knee bent, heel curled up toward buttock, other leg straight on bench.
avoid: Not a leg-curl machine, nor a standing cable curl or kickback.

name: Cable Standing Leg Curl
start: Standing facing low pulley, hands on frame, cuff on one ankle, that leg straight.
finish: Cuffed knee bent, heel curled up toward buttock, thigh still vertical, standing leg straight.
avoid: Not a kneeling leg-curl machine, nor a straight-leg kickback.

name: Cable Leg Extension
start: Seated on bench facing away from low pulley, one ankle cuffed, foot drawn back under bench.
finish: Same seat, cuffed leg straightened out in front, level with the thigh, other foot down.
avoid: Not a leg-extension machine, nor a standing knee raise.

name: Cable Calf Raise
start: Facing low pulley, straight bar held at thighs, balls of both feet on step, heels dropped.
finish: Same hold, risen high onto the balls of both feet, heels well above the step.
avoid: Not a band, machine, Smith or dumbbell calf raise.

name: Cable Tibialis Raise
start: Seated on floor, legs straight toward low pulley, strap over one forefoot, toes pointed at pulley.
finish: Same position, heel still on floor, top of that foot pulled back toward shin, cable taut.
avoid: Not a Smith-machine reverse calf raise, nor a bodyweight wall tibialis raise.

name: Cable Reverse Lunge
start: Facing low pulley, standing tall, feet together, single handle held at chest with both hands.
finish: One leg stepped straight backward, rear knee near floor, front shin upright, handle still at chest.
avoid: Not dumbbells at the sides, nor a twisting or crossover lunge.

name: Cable Lateral Lunge
start: Side-on to low pulley, single handle held at chest with both hands, feet together.
finish: Far leg stepped wide sideways away from stack, knee bent, near leg straight, handle at chest.
avoid: Not a barbell side lunge, nor a forward or crossover lunge.

name: Cable Crossover Step Lunge
start: Side-on to low pulley, single handle held at chest with both hands, feet together.
finish: Near leg crossed in front into a diagonal lunge away from the stack, handle at chest.
avoid: Not an unloaded twisting reverse lunge, nor a curtsy lunge stepping behind.

name: Cable Forward March
start: Marching away from stack, waist belt clipped to waist-high pulley, leaning forward, right knee high.
finish: A step further from stack, cable taut behind, left knee now high, right foot planted.
avoid: Not a sled drag or sprint, nor a band knee raise in place.

name: Cable Standing Knee Drive
start: Standing tall facing away from low pulley, cuff on one ankle, that foot slightly behind.
finish: Cuffed knee driven up to hip height, thigh level, shin vertical, standing leg straight.
avoid: Not a band knee raise, nor a cable adduction or kickback.

name: Cable Dead Bug
start: On back, head toward low pulley, straight bar held above chest, arms straight, knees over hips.
finish: Arms and bar unchanged, one leg straightened out low above floor, other knee still over hip.
avoid: Not a bodyweight dead bug with no cable.

name: Cable Horizontal Chop
start: Standing side-on to chest-high pulley, torso turned toward it, both hands on single handle, arms straight.
finish: Torso rotated away, straight arms swept level across body to far side at chest height.
avoid: Not a high-to-low wood chop or a low-to-high lift.

name: Cable Rotational Row
start: Facing chest-high pulley, staggered stance, single handle in one straight arm, torso twisted, that shoulder forward.
finish: Handle rowed to the ribs, elbow behind body, torso rotated open, that shoulder turned back.
avoid: Not a bent-over one-arm row with the torso staying square.

name: Cable Anti-Rotation Walkout
start: Standing side-on near chest-high pulley, both hands on single handle, arms straight in front of chest.
finish: Side-stepped well away from stack, feet apart mid-step, arms still straight in front, cable taut.
avoid: Not a Pallof press with feet planted and arms pressing out.

name: Alternating Landmine Press
start: Standing square facing anchor, bar end in right hand at right shoulder, left hand free
finish: Right arm locked out up and forward, left hand grabbing bar end beside right hand
avoid: Not a one-arm press with the other hand never touching the bar.

name: Tall-Kneeling Landmine Press
start: Tall-kneeling on both knees facing anchor, hips straight, bar end in right hand at shoulder
finish: Still tall-kneeling, hips straight, right arm locked out pressing bar end up and forward
avoid: Not standing or half-kneeling; both knees down, hips straight.

name: Chest-Supported Landmine Row
start: Chest on incline bench, both hands on landmine bar just behind plates, arms straight
finish: Plates rowed up toward chest, elbows behind torso, chest still on bench
avoid: Not a plate-loaded T-bar row machine with its built-in chest pad.

name: Offset Landmine Row
start: Bent over, left foot forward, landmine bar alongside right leg, right hand gripping it behind plates
finish: Bar rowed up to right hip, elbow behind torso, left hand free, not on knee
avoid: Not a square stance with the free hand resting on the knee.

name: Landmine Split Press
start: Split stance facing anchor, left foot well forward, right foot back, bar end at right shoulder
finish: Same split stance, right arm locked out up and forward, back knee still bent
avoid: Not feet near side by side with only a small stagger.

name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
start: Hips back, knees bent, right hand gripping kettlebell handle on floor between feet
finish: Standing tall, right arm pressed straight overhead, kettlebell resting on back of forearm
avoid: Not starting with the bell racked, and not two kettlebells.

name: Lateral Goblet Squat
start: Standing in wide stance, kettlebell held by the horns at chest, both legs straight.
finish: Same wide stance, sat down over one bent leg, other leg straight, kettlebell still at chest.
avoid: Not a centered two-leg goblet squat, nor a barbell side lunge.

name: Single-Leg Box Jump
start: Facing plyo box on right leg, knee bent, left foot off floor, arms swung back
finish: Landed on top of box on right foot only, knee bent, left foot still off box
avoid: Not a two-foot take-off, and not a foot starting on the box.

name: Depth Drop to Stick
start: Standing tall on plyo box, toes at front edge, feet hip-width, arms at sides
finish: Landed on floor in front of box on both feet, half squat, hips back, arms forward
avoid: Not rebounding into a jump, and no second box ahead.

name: Assisted Nordic Hamstring Curl
start: Kneeling upright, ankles pinned under padded bar, band from high anchor behind looped around chest.
finish: Body lowered far forward, straight from knees to head, band stretched taut from behind.
avoid: Not an unassisted Nordic curl, with no band holding the chest.

name: Side Plank Hip Adduction
start: Forearm side plank, top ankle on flat bench, hips up, bottom leg hanging down toward floor.
finish: Same plank, hips still up, bottom leg raised to meet the bench under the top leg.
avoid: Not a static Copenhagen plank hold, nor a plain side plank on the floor.

name: Sled March
start: Leaning into loaded sled, hands on high posts, right knee driven up, left foot planted behind
finish: Next step: left knee driven up, right foot planted behind, hands still on high posts
avoid: Not a sprint with both feet off the ground, nor low handles.

name: Battle Rope Slams
start: Standing tall, one rope end in each hand, both arms raised together overhead
finish: Half squat, both arms slammed down together, both ropes hitting floor in matching waves
avoid: Not alternating arms, one hand up while the other is down.

name: March with arm swing
start: Marching in place, left knee lifted to hip height, right arm forward, left arm back
finish: Sides switched: right knee up to hip height, left arm forward, right arm back
avoid: Not a high-knee run with both feet airborne, and not arms held still.

name: Lateral shuffle with reach
start: Athletic half-squat, feet close but apart, arms low by sides, moving sideways to the right
finish: Right foot stepped out wide, knees still bent, both arms reaching straight overhead
avoid: Not a banded walk, cone hop or crossover step; feet never cross.

name: Carioca hip switch
start: Moving sideways left, chest facing forward, right leg crossed in front of left, hips turned left
finish: Still moving left, chest facing forward, right leg crossed behind left, hips turned right
avoid: Not a quick-step drill where feet never cross and hips stay square.

name: Backpedal to march
start: Backpedalling (running backward), knees bent, shoulders over toes, left foot stepping back
finish: Halted upright in a march: right knee at hip height, left arm forward
avoid: Not running or marching forward, and not a backward sled walk.

name: Ankle pogo pulse
start: Standing tall on balls of both feet, heels slightly up, knees almost straight, arms relaxed
finish: Both feet a few inches off the floor, legs nearly straight, feet only slightly pointed
avoid: Not skipping rope, and not big tucked hops over cones or hurdles.

name: Half-kneeling ankle rock
start: Half-kneeling, right knee down, left foot flat close in front, left shin vertical
finish: Left knee pushed forward well past left toes, left heel still flat on floor
avoid: Not a long kneeling lunge stretch with the front shin staying vertical.

name: Knee-to-wall dorsiflexion
start: Facing wall in split stance, left toes a few inches from wall, hands on wall
finish: Left knee bent forward touching wall, left heel still flat on floor
avoid: Not leaning on the wall with the back leg straight and heel down.

name: Heel-to-toe walk
start: Walking step, left heel touching floor, left toes pulled up high, right foot behind
finish: Rolled onto left toes, left heel raised high, right leg swinging forward past it
avoid: Not a tandem walk heel-against-toe on a line, and not running.

name: Tibialis wall raise
start: Back and hips against wall, heels about a foot out, both feet flat on floor
finish: Still leaning on wall, toes of both feet lifted high, only heels touching floor
avoid: Not a barbell or Smith machine toe raise, nor rising onto the toes.

name: Calf-raise walk
start: Walking up on balls of feet, heels high, left foot stepping forward, right behind
finish: Next step: right foot forward on its toes, both heels still high off floor
avoid: Not a stationary calf raise in place, with or without weights.

name: Supported hip airplane
start: On right leg, hinged forward with torso level, left leg straight back, right hand on wall
finish: Pelvis and chest turned open to left, left hip up, right hand still on wall
avoid: Not a kettlebell single-leg deadlift where the hips never rotate.

name: 90/90 hip transition
start: Seated, both knees bent 90 degrees: right shin across front, left shin pointing back
finish: Knees swung over to other side: left shin across front, right shin pointing back, chest upright
avoid: Not lying on the back with one thigh held up, straightening that knee.

name: Shin-box get-up
start: Seated in 90/90 shin box: right shin across front, left shin pointing back, hands free
finish: Standing tall on both feet, risen straight up out of the shin box
avoid: Not a kettlebell Turkish get-up, and not stopping in tall kneeling.

name: Adductor frog rock
start: On forearms, knees spread very wide, feet in line behind knees, hips in line with knees
finish: Hips rocked back toward heels, knees still wide, forearms still on floor
avoid: Not a wide-knee child's pose with feet together behind, nor frog jumps.

name: Half-kneeling adductor rock-back
start: Right knee down, left leg straight out to side, foot flat, hands on floor under shoulders
finish: Hips rocked back toward right heel, left leg still straight, back flat, hands planted
avoid: Not a kneeling lunge stretch with the free foot placed in front.

name: Cossack squat shift
start: Very wide stance, toes slightly out, standing tall, hands together at chest
finish: Hips sunk low over bent right knee, left leg straight, left heel down, toes up
avoid: Not a loaded barbell side squat; bodyweight only, feet stay planted.

name: Split-stance hip flexor pulse
start: Long split stance, left foot forward, right heel up, hands on hips, torso upright
finish: Feet unmoved, hips pressed forward, right thigh angled back, knee off floor, torso upright
avoid: Not a deep reverse lunge, and not kneeling on the back knee.

name: Half-kneeling hip flexor reach
start: Half-kneeling, right knee down, left foot forward, torso upright, arms relaxed at sides
finish: Hips shifted forward, right arm reaching straight overhead, torso tall, right knee still down
avoid: Not a hands-on-hips kneeling stretch with no overhead arm reach.

name: Walking hamstring sweep
start: Stepped forward, right heel down ahead with toes up, right leg straight, torso upright
finish: Hinged forward with flat back, left knee bent, both hands sweeping low past right foot
avoid: Not a static hold gripping the ankle with a rounded back.

name: Single-leg RDL reach
start: Standing tall on left leg, right foot just off floor, arms at sides
finish: Hinged on left leg, torso and straight right leg level, hips square, hands reaching down
avoid: Not holding a kettlebell, and not raised leg bent with hips turned open.

name: Glute bridge march
start: Lying face up, both feet flat, hips raised in line with knees and shoulders
finish: Hips still raised and level, right foot lifted, right thigh vertical, knee bent
avoid: Not a single-leg bridge with one leg held straight while hips rise.

name: Reverse lunge to knee drive
start: Bottom of reverse lunge: left foot forward, right knee just above floor, torso upright
finish: Standing on left leg, right knee driven up to hip height, left arm swung forward
avoid: Not holding dumbbells, and not a box step-up with knee raise.

name: Bodyweight squat pry
start: Standing, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, palms pressed together at chest
finish: Deep squat, hips below knees, palms together, elbows inside knees pushing them apart
avoid: Not a goblet squat holding a kettlebell, and not hands behind head.

name: Lateral lunge rock
start: Wide stance, feet flat, toes forward, hips back over bent right leg, left leg straight
finish: Shifted across without stepping: hips back over bent left leg, right leg straight, feet flat
avoid: Not a barbell side squat, and not stepping the feet in and out.

name: World’s greatest lunge
start: Long lunge, left foot forward, right hand on floor, left elbow dropped inside left foot
finish: Same lunge, right hand still down, chest turned left, left arm reaching straight to ceiling
avoid: Not an elbow-drop lunge without the arm rotating up to the ceiling.

name: Cat-camel segmental spine
start: On hands and knees, hands under shoulders, back rounded up high, head dropped
finish: Same position, back arched down, belly toward floor, chest and head lifted
avoid: Not a flat back to rounded back only, with no arched position.

name: Quadruped thoracic rotation
start: On hands and knees, left hand planted, right hand behind head, right elbow toward left wrist
finish: Upper back rotated open, right elbow pointing up to ceiling, left hand still planted
avoid: Not a thread-the-needle stretch with the shoulder lowered to the floor.

name: Side-lying open book
start: Lying on left side, knees bent and stacked, both arms straight in front, palms together
finish: Right arm swept open toward floor on other side, chest turned up, knees still stacked
avoid: Not a side-bend with the top arm overhead, and not knees separating.

name: Tall-kneeling rotation reach
start: Kneeling tall on both knees, thighs upright, arms straight forward at chest height, palms together
finish: Thighs still upright, hips facing forward, chest turned right, right arm reaching back at shoulder height
avoid: Not standing or sitting on the heels, and not holding a ball or cable.

name: Dead bug reach
start: Lying face up, hips and knees bent 90 degrees, shins level, both arms straight up
finish: Right arm lowered behind head toward floor, left leg straight just above floor, other limbs unmoved
avoid: Not a leg-only dead bug with both arms kept pointing up.

name: Bird dog reach
start: On hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips, back flat
finish: Right arm reaching straight forward, left leg straight back, both level with back
avoid: Not a leg-only raise with both hands staying on the floor.

name: Plank shoulder tap
start: High plank on straight arms, hands under shoulders, feet hip-width apart, body straight
finish: Right hand lifted to touch left shoulder, left arm straight, hips still level
avoid: Not a forearm plank, and not a push-up with both hands down.

name: Side plank reach-through
start: Side plank on left forearm, elbow under shoulder, feet stacked, right arm straight up
finish: Hips still lifted, chest turned toward floor, right arm reaching through under torso
avoid: Not a hand-on-hip side plank with hips dipping and lifting.

name: Bear crawl
start: On hands and toes, knees hovering just off floor, right hand and left foot reaching forward
finish: Next step: left hand and right foot reaching forward, knees still hovering, back flat
avoid: Not hips high with legs nearly straight, and no sled or harness.

name: Tall-kneeling Pallof press
start: Kneeling tall on both knees, side-on to cable, both hands holding handle at chest
finish: Arms pressed straight out from chest, torso still facing forward, thighs upright
avoid: Not standing, and not turning the torso toward the cable.

name: Half-kneeling chop pattern
start: Half-kneeling, left knee down, right foot forward, high pulley on right, rope held high
finish: Rope pulled down across body to left hip, chest turned left, hips still facing forward
avoid: Not standing with the back foot pivoting, and not a low-to-high lift.

name: Shoulder pass-through
start: Standing, dowel held with very wide overhand grip against front of thighs, arms straight
finish: Dowel now behind the hips after passing overhead, arms still straight, same wide grip
avoid: Not elbows bent with the dowel parked behind the head.

name: Scapular wall slide
start: Facing wall, forearms vertical on wall, little-finger sides touching, elbows at shoulder height
finish: Forearms slid up the wall into a Y overhead, elbows nearly straight, forearms still touching
avoid: Not standing with the back against the wall, and not one arm only.

name: Push-up plus
start: High plank on hands, elbows straight, chest sunk between shoulder blades, blades drawn together
finish: Same straight arms, upper back pushed up and rounded, shoulder blades spread apart
avoid: Not a regular push-up with elbows bending to lower the chest.

name: Wall shoulder flexion lift-off
start: Facing wall, toes near wall, both arms straight overhead, little-finger edges of hands on wall
finish: Both straight arms lifted a few inches off wall, overhead, torso still upright
avoid: Not a free-standing overhead stretch with no wall, nor a one-arm lean.

name: Quadruped scapular circle
start: On hands and knees, elbows slightly bent, chest sunk, shoulder blades pinched and shrugged toward ears
finish: Upper back pushed up, shoulder blades spread apart and down away from ears, elbows slightly bent
avoid: Not rounding the whole spine like a cat stretch; only shoulder blades move.

name: Face pull to external rotation
start: Standing facing face-height pulley, one rope end in each hand, arms straight toward stack
finish: Rope pulled apart to face, elbows at shoulder height, forearms vertical, hands beside ears
avoid: Not finishing with hands in front of the face and forearms level.

name: Prone Y raise
start: Lying face down, forehead down, straight arms overhead in a Y on floor, thumbs up
finish: Straight arms lifted a few inches in the Y, thumbs up, chest and legs still down
avoid: Not a Superman lifting chest and legs, and not an incline bench with weights.

name: Quadruped wrist rock
start: On hands and knees, palms flat, fingers pointing forward, shoulders directly over wrists
finish: Rocked forward, shoulders in front of hands, palms still flat, fingers forward, elbows straight
avoid: Not fingers pointing back toward the knees with the body rocking backward.

name: Wrist extension glide
start: Standing, right arm straight forward, palm down, wrist level, left hand under right fingers
finish: Left hand easing right fingers up and back, wrist bent back, palm facing forward, elbow straight
avoid: Not on all fours leaning on the hands, and not a dumbbell wrist curl.

name: Wrist flexion glide
start: Standing, right arm straight forward, palm down, wrist level, left palm on back of right hand
finish: Left hand pressing right hand down, right wrist bent, fingers pointing to floor, elbow straight
avoid: Not a seated dumbbell wrist curl, and not bending the wrist backward.

name: Forearm pronation-supination
start: Standing, right elbow bent 90 degrees at side, forearm forward, palm facing up
finish: Elbow still tucked at side, forearm turned over, right palm now facing down
avoid: Not rotating the upper arm at the shoulder, and not holding a dumbbell.

name: Finger extension band open
start: Standing, right hand raised at chest, fingertips and thumb bunched together inside rubber band
finish: Same hand opened wide, fingers and thumb spread apart, band stretched around fingertips
avoid: Not curling a barbell with the fingers or pinching a plate.

name: Snap-down to stick
start: Standing tall up on toes, both arms reaching straight overhead, feet hip-width
finish: Dropped in place to athletic quarter squat, feet flat, hips back, arms pulled down behind
avoid: Not a jump landing, and not stepping or dropping off a box.

name: A-skip rhythm drill
start: Skipping tall on right forefoot, left thigh lifted level, left toes up, right arm forward
finish: Next skip: right thigh lifted level, right toes up, left arm forward, on left forefoot
avoid: Not a low skip with little knee lift, and not leaning on a wall.

name: Progressive build-up run
start: Jogging on flat ground, upright, short easy stride, arms relaxed and low
finish: Same flat ground, running fast with longer stride, higher knee and bigger arm swing
avoid: Not a treadmill or trail run, nor a crouched sprint start.

name: Light medicine-ball scoop pattern
start: Wide stance, hips back, torso turned right, light medicine ball held low outside right hip
finish: Torso turned left, right heel up, ball swung up and across to chest height, arms long
avoid: Not a front-facing scoop thrown backward over the head.

name: Empty-bar press rehearsal
start: Lying on flat bench, feet flat, empty barbell held straight-armed above chest, no plates
finish: Empty bar lowered to touch mid-chest, elbows bent, feet still flat on floor
avoid: Not a loaded bar: no plates on it at all.

name: Band row rehearsal
start: Standing facing band anchored at chest height, one band end in each hand, arms straight
finish: Hands pulled to lower ribs, elbows behind torso, band stretched taut to anchor
avoid: Not standing on the band and pulling up to the chin.

name: Supported dead hang
start: Standing under a bar at overhead reach height, both hands gripping overhand, shoulder-width
finish: Hanging with arms straight, knees bent, toes still lightly touching the floor
avoid: Not one-handed, and not feet off the floor in a free hang.

name: Split-stance row rehearsal
start: Upright split stance facing chest-height pulley, left foot forward, right arm straight holding handle
finish: Right elbow pulled back beside ribs, handle at lower chest, chest still facing pulley
avoid: Not twisting the torso open toward the rowing side, nor a deep forward lean.
